name: Jetpack Clankers
summary:
Jetpack Clankers is a **social VR racing game** where your hands are jet engines, your legs are wheels, and staying in control is half the battle.

Blast through massive arenas at extreme speeds using chaotic, physics-based movement that is easy to try and hard to master. Boost, drift, climb, crash, recover, and find faster lines as you race through wild robot playgrounds built for speed, skill, and ridiculous moments.

But racing is only part of it. Hang out with other Clankers, shoot blasters, throw toys,
